short_title: How many holes does a pair of pants have? 👖 #shorts
short_description:
Three openings... but how many holes? In topology, a hole is a tunnel you can pass through. Stretch a pair of pants without tearing or gluing and it flattens into a shape with exactly two holes.

The rule for a one-piece tube-like object: holes = openings minus one. A straw: 2 openings, 1 hole. Pants: 3 openings, 2 holes. Pockets don't count: a pocket is a dead end, not a tunnel.

Now your turn: how many holes does a T-shirt have? Comment your answer 👇 The reveal is in Saturday's puzzle video.

Part 1, the straw debate: https://youtube.com/shorts/0kQmb0qDEqg
